blinding_guess.why: Two things visible in the code already read, no further checks made. (1) thrust: in throttle_cb (setpoint_attitude.cpp:207-210) the reverse_throttle branch only returns when the value is outside [-1,1]; when reverse_throttle is true and the value is inside that range, control falls through to the else-if that re-checks [0.0, 1.0], so every negative throttle is dropped with a warning and the documented reverse range (-1..1) can never reach the FCU. (2) q and body_*_rate: the only frame conversion in this revision is one function, a +pi rotation about X (uas_frame_conversions.cpp:25, quaternion_from_rpy(M_PI,0,0)), aliased as both _enu_ned and _ned_enu (mavros_uas.h:410-421); it is applied by conjugation to a world-frame orientation (:121) and as a rotation to the body angular-velocity vector (:141). A pi roll about X maps (x,y,z) to (x,-y,-z), which is an axis flip of y and z, not the ENU<->NED axis swap, so at least one of the two uses cannot be a correct frame conversion. (1) is a definite logic defect in a listed element; (2) is a strong suspicion about the q/body-rate elements.

notes: Definition source: SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET is a MAVLink message; its definition (common.xml / generated mavlink_msg_set_attitude_target.h) is NOT in the snapshot. The snapshot only depends on the external ROS 'mavlink' package (mavros/package.xml:35) and includes <mavlink/v1.0/<dialect>/mavlink.h> via libmavconn/include/mavconn/mavlink_dialect.h:55-79 (build-time MAVLINK_DIALECT, CMake default 'ardupilotmega' in MavrosMavlink.cmake:14, .travis.yml matrix common/pixhawk, no mavlink version pinned anywhere in the snapshot). ros_distro is null, so there is no release tag at which a dependency file could be fetched, and MAVLink XML is not one of the permitted definition-file types; no external fetch was attempted. Consequently definition_id is null on every port and declares[msg:common/SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET] is null (the msg template requires the hash). The field types in declares come from the plugin's own wrapper signature set_attitude_target(uint32_t time_boot_ms, uint8_t type_mask, float q[4], float roll_rate, float pitch_rate, float yaw_rate, float thrust) (setpoint_attitude.cpp:90-94) and from UAS::get_tgt_system/get_tgt_component returning uint8_t (mavros_uas.h:161,168); the pairing of wrapper parameters with the MAVLink field names body_roll_rate/body_pitch_rate/body_yaw_rate is by parameter name and positional order into mavlink_msg_set_attitude_target_pack_chan (:96-102), whose signature is not in the snapshot. The 'common' dialect qualifier in msg_type is taken from the packet; the snapshot cannot confirm which dialect file defines the message. Plugin facts: send-only (get_rx_handlers returns empty, :70-72); registered in mavros_plugins.xml:44 ('Send to FCU external attitude setpoint.'); built into libmavros_plugins (mavros/CMakeLists.txt:204); enabled by default for PX4 (not in px4_pluginlists.yaml blacklist) and blacklisted for APM (apm_pluginlists.yaml:6). Three send paths fill the message: pose_cb/transform_cb -> send_attitude_target (type_mask (1<<6)|(7<<0), q from ENU pose/transform via transform_frame_enu_ned, rates 0, thrust 0; :113-128); twist_cb -> send_attitude_ang_velocity (type_mask (1<<7)|(1<<6), q={1,0,0,0}, rates from TwistStamped.twist.angular via transform_frame_enu_ned, thrust 0; :135-148); throttle_cb -> send_attitude_throttle (type_mask (1<<7)|(7<<0), q={1,0,0,0}, rates 0, thrust from std_msgs/Float64; :153-163). q ordering is stated in code as 'w x y z' (:119). time_boot_ms is the ROS stamp (or ros::Time::now() for throttle) in ns divided by 1e6 and passed as uint32_t (:123,:143,:158); it is not FCU boot time. QoS fields are null because this is ROS 1; the consumed topics use subscriber queue size 10 (:63,:64,:67). rate_hz is null because no send rate is set for the message; tf/rate_limit (default 10.0, :55, config yamls :92) only bounds the TF-listener path (setpoint_mixin.h:87-101), which replaces the topic subscribers when tf/listen is true (:57-65). When tf/listen is true the plugin also consumes TF frames named by tf/frame_id (default 'local_origin') and tf/child_frame_id (default 'attitude'). exclusive is empty: the plugin claims no device handle; it sends through UAS_FCU(uas)->send_message (:103). No element is undetermined: all ten packet elements are positively filled/sent by the code, so not_declared is empty. Side observation outside the packet elements: mavros/src/mavros/setpoint.py:29 creates a PoseStamped publisher for the setpoint_attitude 'cmd_vel' topic whereas the plugin subscribes TwistStamped on it (:63); not recorded as a port because it is a Python helper, not the plugin. Confidence is medium because the field types are code-derived rather than definition-derived and no definition hash could be computed.
